hypotheses.name: overshoot precedes the runaway
hypotheses.prediction: in >= 80% of diverged champion cells the rolling amplification exceeds one at or before onset
hypotheses.statement: divergence begins when single online updates start making the sample they learned from worse

hypotheses.name: stable learners do not overshoot
hypotheses.prediction: the rolling amplification never exceeds one in >= 80% of non-diverged champion cells and in >= 80% of lr-0.01 cells
hypotheses.statement: cells that stay stable, and the lr-0.01 learner, keep single-step amplification below one

hypotheses.name: the input-3 channel carries the curvature growth
hypotheses.prediction: in >= 80% of diverged champion cells the median input-3 share of the displacement curvature over the 40 learning steps before onset exceeds its median over steps (40, 120)
hypotheses.statement: overshoot arrives because the gate-weight curvature attached to input 3 grows with the error it feeds back
